caption: The drawing depicts a single, ornately carved wooden armchair positioned at a slight angle to the viewer. The chair features a high back with intricate scroll and foliage motifs along the side supports and top rail, rendered in shades of brown. Both the backrest and the seat are composed of a tightly woven cane material, colored in a light, beige tone. The armrests are solid and curve outward with slight scrolls at the front ends. The chair legs are turned with bulbous shapes and additional scroll elements that connect the front legs near the base, forming horizontal stretchers with more decorative details. The background is plain and off-white, and there are no other objects or decorations depicted in the drawing.
title: Armchair
